test_item:
DebugAuth shall verify received files and rejects them if verification fails.
(manifest, SAM certificate and manifest signature are all valid)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Read the SAM certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in SAMcert.pem -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData package that passes verification + trigger
4. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows the certificate in x509 PEM format
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
3. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData package that passes verification + trigger
4. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the successful verification entry
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
